mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, check how I feel, and sit on the edge of the bed before standing.
mara.intention: Begin gently and notice whether I have enough energy for the day.

mara.activity: Wash up, change into workout clothes, and gather my things for the short strength session.
mara.intention: Get ready without letting the morning become rushed.

mara.activity: Do my short strength workout and shower afterward.
mara.intention: Keep my usual Friday movement routine and arrive at work alert.

mara.activity: Dress for the studio, have a quick breakfast, and leave for work.
mara.intention: Be ready for the workday with a little margin before the first meeting.

mara.activity: Work at the studio on planting plans, coordination, and site-visit preparation.
mara.intention: Move the active projects forward and keep the client revisions organized.

mara.activity: Take a proper lunch break and review the afternoon schedule.
mara.intention: Eat before the second half of the workday rather than running on coffee.

mara.activity: Attend site visits and client meetings, then close out urgent studio notes.
mara.intention: Finish the workday cleanly enough to protect the evening for family and ceramics.

mara.activity: Come home, remove my shoes, place my keys in the open entryway, and set my field notebook on the living room sideboard countertop.
mara.intention: Mark the transition home without scattering work things through the house.

mara.activity: Call my parent or older relative about the health, appointment, or future-arrangement concern, listening carefully and making a few notes.
mara.intention: Sound calm while clarifying what actually needs to happen next.

mara.activity: Change into comfortable clothes, pack the ceramics things, and eat a small piece of fruit before leaving.
mara.intention: Go to class steady rather than distracted or hungry.

mara.activity: Attend the second ceramics class and work through the exercise without trying to make the piece client-perfect.
mara.intention: Stay present with being a beginner and enjoy the separate social world of the class.

mara.activity: Return home, make toast and scrambled eggs at the kitchen island, and eat quietly.
mara.intention: Have a warm, uncomplicated dinner while Julian is at service.

mara.activity: Rinse the plate and skillet, wipe the island, put the ceramics things together for the next class, and leave them neatly by the tote bag.
mara.intention: Restore enough order that the family concern does not turn into late-night housework.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into sleep pants and a sleep shirt, and put my phone on its charger.
mara.intention: Let the day settle before bed.

mara.activity: Get into bed, place my reading glasses on top of my nightstand, read a few pages, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Close the evening with something contained and quiet.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes while checking how I feel and whether she is resting comfortably.
julian.intention: Start gently and give myself a quiet buffer before the workday.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Get clean and ready without making extra decisions.

julian.activity: Make coffee and a small breakfast, carry them to the kitchen island, and eat while listening to a few quiet minutes of piano music.
julian.intention: Put something solid in my stomach before prep.

julian.activity: Pack my backpack, fill the thermos, collect my keys from the piano middle shelf, and check the restaurant notebook and menu folder.
julian.intention: Leave with the things I need for deliveries and kitchen management.
Get in ahead of the prep window and deliveries.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, ordering details, and kitchen management; check produce, organize the prep list, and set up the line for dinner.
julian.intention: Make the crowded Friday service as orderly as possible before the evening rush.

julian.activity: Travel home with the thermos and backpack.
julian.intention: Get home for a short reset before returning for service.

julian.activity: Bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, put my backpack near the island, and leave the restaurant notebook on the island with receipts tucked inside.
julian.intention: Unload the workday without trying to fully tidy the kitchen.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of leftovers or yogurt and fruit, drink water, and sit quietly in the main bedroom to reset.
julian.intention: Recover some energy and keep the pre-service stretch from becoming frantic.

julian.activity: Review the service notes, change into a clean chef jacket and apron, and send Mara a short practical message before leaving.
julian.intention: Close the home part of the day and make sure Mara knows when I expect to be back.

julian.activity: Collect my backpack and keys and travel back to the restaurant.
julian.intention: Arrive with enough time to check the line before guests arrive.

julian.activity: Run Friday dinner service and closing duties, coordinating the kitchen, tasting sauces, managing mistakes, and finishing the close.
julian.intention: Keep the team fed, calm, and moving through the long service.
Come down from service gradually rather than carrying the whole kitchen through the front door.

julian.activity: Bring the thermos into the kitchen, set it beside the sink, put my backpack near the island, and drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table.
julian.intention: Put down what is in my hands before I do anything else.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep clothes without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Use the familiar post-service routine to quiet my body and head.

julian.activity: Drink water, put my phone on its charger, and leave my wallet and earplugs where they are for the morning.
julian.intention: Finish the night with as little decision-making as possible.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara and settle into sleep.
julian.intention: Rest after the long Friday service.
